clauses.reason: This clause delegates the President's section 501(c) functions to the Secretary of State and directs assistance at named sites. Executive Order 12251, signed November 15, 1980, states "Executive Order No. 12246 of O ctober 10,1980, is revoked." and "This Order is effective Novem ber 15,1980."; the end date is therefore 1980-11-15, the same as its signing date. The text of the delegation in this order reads "All the functions vested in the President by Section 501(c) of the Refugee Education A ssistance A ct of 1980, are hereby delegated to the Secretary of State.".

research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text (45 FR 68367, issue of October 15, 1980) is Executive Order 12246, signed October 10, 1980, concerning assistance to Cuban and Haitian entrants. I read the whole order: a recital of authority, a delegation to the Secretary of State of the President's functions under section 501(c) of the Refugee Education Assistance Act of 1980 (section 1-101), and a direction that the Secretary ensure assistance at named camps and reception sites (section 1-102). The representation is the machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF; page images were not inspected. End: Executive Order 12251 (signed November 15, 1980; 45 FR 76085, issue of November 18, 1980) states in its section 1-105 "Executive Order No. 12246 of O ctober 10,1980, is revoked." and in section 1-106 "This Order is effective Novem ber 15,1980.". It re-delegates the same section 501(c) functions to the Secretary of Health and Human Services in its section 1-103. I searched the held texts for the number 12246 and found no earlier revocation or own-terms end; the order states no sunset.
